newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish Jan-Apr mobile phone wholesales up 61 pct.
newsitem.headline: Finnish Jan-Apr mobile phone wholesales up 61 pct.

text.p: Wholesales of mobile phones in Finland hit an all-time monthly record of 91,000 units in April, boosting January-April wholesales to a 61 percent year-on-year rise to 222,500 units, a branch lobby said on Friday.
In the first quarter, mobile phone wholesales had increased 40 percent year-on-year, the electronics wholesalers association said earlier.
"April sales were up by about 300 percent. Normal monthly sales figures have been around 30-40,000 units," association managing director Pentti Karhu said by telephone.
In a statement, the association said the 91,000 mobile phones delivered to retailers in April was "an all-time record".
In full-year 1996, mobile handset wholesales in Finland totalled 500,000 units.
